claude-opus-5-5.title: CRYSTAL KIZOMBA CONGRESS
claude-opus-5-5.description:
Welcome to
💎 💎 💎 CKC 💎 💎 💎
💎 CRYSTAL KIZOMBA CONGRESS
💎 23 – 26 April 2027 💎
💎 in Vienna/AUSTRIA 💎
💎Enjoy the greatest Kizomba Congress in Austria💎
💎4 th CRYSTAL Edition💎
Get ready for the next unforgettable experience –
In the spirit of the Phoenix Era 2027, we’re embracing transformation and renewal within the dance community. Just like the mythical phoenix rises from the ashes, we invite you to rise with us, explore new styles, and ignite your passion for Kizomba. This is more than just a dance event; it’s a celebration of culture, community, and creativity.
Join us for a weekend filled with passion, rhythm, and connection as we dive into the vibrant world of Kizomba again. Whether you’re a seasoned dancer or just starting out, this congress is designed for everyone who loves to dance UrbanKiz, Kizomba, Semba, Tarraxo and Ghetto Zouk.
Expect a fantastic lineup of workshops led by world-class instructors, electrifying performances, and plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow dancers from around the globe. Whether you want to enhance your skills, learn new moves, or simply enjoy the music and atmosphere, the 💎Crystal Kizomba Congress💎 is the place to be.
Get your pass now and have a fantastic time with us.
Tickets: https://my.weezevent.com/ckc-crystal-kizomba-congress
💎 Your weekend package:
💎3 days of festival
💎3 legendary party nights
💎3 afternoon socials
💎3 days of workshops
💎2 rooms – 2 atmospheres
💎Surprise
💎Live performance
💎Exclusive masterclasses
💎International guest dancers
💎Balance by Taxiteams
💎United by colourful party dress codes
💎Fashion & shoe corner
💎Cocktails and drinks at the Festival-Bar
💎Lunch and dinner offer
💎More than 60 hours of dance – feel devine
Thursday Pre-party and
Monday After Social Party –
(not included in the Full Pass)
💎Room I : Urbankiz – Tarraxo- Ghettozouk – Afrobeat – Douceur
💎Room II : Authentic Kizomba – Semba – Afrozouk – Kompa
So, mark your calendars, gather your friends, and prepare for an incredible journey into the heart of Kizomba. Let’s make memories that will last a lifetime and celebrate the dawn of a new era together and enjoy the magic of Crystal!
💎 We can’t wait to see you there!
💎VENUE:
Hotel Meliá Vienna
Donau-City-Straße 7
1220 Wien
💎 International Artists
💎 30 Workshops
💎 80 Hours dancing
💎 Taxi- und Guest Dancers
💎 3 Socials
💎 3 Evening Partys 11pm – 6 am
💎 2 Dancefloors and 2 Atmospheres
Feel like you’re in a wonderland – 4 days full of dance, exchange, good vibes, positive energy, and laughter. Let your heart decide which dance workshop you want to attend – Kizomba, Urban Kiz, Kizomba Fusion, Semba, Kompa, Tarraxo or Afro – improve your level or refresh your knowledge and learn from our best international artists.
